tips: Focus video scripts exclusively on high-performing business niches: Mobile Phone Shops, Cafes, Jewellery Shops, and Pharmacies, while stopping scripts for schools, travel agencies, and electronics shops.
Prioritize Arabic and Urdu scripts over English, as Arabic (1.02) and Urdu (0.90) strongly outperform English (0.62).
Drop generic hooks and titles like 'Supercharge Your Business' or 'Boost Your Business Instantly'; instead use direct, localized store-growth hooks like 'ارتقِ بمتجرك' or 'بزنس کو آگے بڑھائیں'.
Focus script messaging on custom Websites, Mobile Apps, and POS software solutions; avoid standalone 'AutoPilot AI' or generic social media pitches which have the lowest performance.
End every video with a clear call-to-action directing store owners to send a WhatsApp message for a free live demo, without ever referencing prices.
